scope: Repository architecture audit for capability foundation
decision: Evolve the existing platform. Do not rebuild. Preserve proven runtimes and introduce a strategic capability kernel above existing services.

findings.reason: Boundaries and contracts are already explicit and aligned with the target architecture.
They correctly model atomic operations and impact, but previously mixed strategic capabilities, operations and governance concepts. They remain supported below the new strategic model.
Keep separate services, but map them under stable strategic capabilities instead of creating another combined runtime.
These are replaceable experiences and workspaces, not platform capabilities.
No subsystem is retired in this migration because available evidence does not justify destructive removal.

risks.mitigation: Separate strategic capability model from atomic operation registry.
Use review-capability registry with configurable assignee references.
Add compatibility runtime and keep all existing service APIs unchanged.

migration_policy: No breaking changes to existing services
Every strategic capability must resolve contracts, reviews and registered services
Future features must trace to a strategic capability
